source: DOTAX Annual Report FY2024-25, Table 1.8 (cash collections, all funds)

taxes.name: General excise & use (GET)
taxes.who: 4% (4.5% with the Oʻahu surcharge) on nearly every transaction — everyone pays it at the register

taxes.name: Individual income tax
taxes.who: Tax on residents' income — the gold streams on the map

taxes.name: Transient accommodations (TAT)
taxes.who: 10.25% on hotel and vacation-rental stays — mostly visitors

taxes.name: County GET surcharge
taxes.who: 0.5% GET add-on collected for the counties — funds rail on Oʻahu

taxes.name: Estate tax
taxes.who: Tax on large estates — spiky from year to year

taxes.name: Unemployment insurance
taxes.who: Employer contributions to the unemployment trust fund

taxes.name: Insurance premiums tax
taxes.who: Levy on insurers, paid in lieu of GET

taxes.name: Fuel taxes
taxes.who: Per-gallon taxes at the pump — fund the highways

taxes.name: Public service companies
taxes.who: Utilities pay this instead of GET

taxes.name: Motor vehicle tax & fees
taxes.who: State registration weight tax and fees

taxes.name: Conveyance tax
taxes.who: On real-estate sales, graduated by price

taxes.name: All other taxes & fees
taxes.who: Financial corporations, environmental response ($1.05/barrel on petroleum), licenses and fees
